LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_I.label: solar fluid simulation array
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_I.description: A research bench for Solarite research projects. It needs a Kylar-Xar effect computer linked to it. Linked to other arrays, autoscopes or dark mirrors, it also speeds up their research.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_II.label: sigma-class sagittary autoscope
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_II.description: A research bench for kwazaari research projects. It needs a Kylar-Xar effect computer and a solar fluid simulation array linked to it. Linked to other autoscopes or to dark mirrors, it also speeds up their research.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_III.label: dark mirror
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_III.description: A research bench for tenebral research projects. It needs a Kylar-Xar effect computer and a sigma-class sagittary autoscope linked to it. Linked to other dark mirrors or to umbral spires, it also speeds up their research.
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_IV.label: umbral spire
LanguageData.BOR_Research_Unlocker_IV.description: A research bench for Umbral research projects. It needs a Kylar-Xar effect computer and a dark mirror linked to it. Linked to other umbral spires, it also speeds up their research.
